about: Sediment ledger: every entry is a claim plus the machines that can contradict it today. Probes recompute live through public callables; artifact checks pin a value at a JSON pointer and the artifact digest; doc checks pin a verbatim phrase the prose must still contain. Edited only after re-verification; the guard (tools/sediment_guard.py) is the reader.

entries.title: Wigley block coefficient is the rational n m/((n+1)(m+1))
entries.claim: Cb = n m/((n+1)(m+1)); 4/9 at n = m = 2 (the classic Wigley form).
entries.acceptance: live closed form equals 4/9 to 1e-15 relative; docs/wigley.md still tabulates the same expression and the 4/9 value

entries.title: Cp, Cm, Cwp of the Wigley form are all 2/3 at n = m = 2 and Cb = Cp*Cm
entries.claim: Cp = n/(n+1) = 2/3, Cm = m/(m+1) = 2/3, Cwp = n/(n+1) = 2/3, and 2/3*2/3 = 4/9 = Cb (the module's cheapest self-check).
entries.acceptance: each coefficient equals 2/3 to 1e-15 relative; the product of the two live values equals the live Cb to 1e-15 relative

entries.title: Wigley displacement volume at the ITTC reference case L/B = 10, B/T = 1.6
entries.acceptance: live closed form equals 25/9 to 1e-15 relative

entries.title: Wigley waterplane area at the ITTC reference case
entries.acceptance: live closed form equals 20/3 to 1e-15 relative

entries.title: Wigley vertical centre of buoyancy is 5T/8 above the keel at m = 2
entries.acceptance: live closed form equals 0.390625 to 1e-15 relative

entries.title: Wigley wetted surface at L/B = 10, B/T = 1.6 (no elementary primitive: Gauss-Legendre)
entries.claim: S = 14.879063105 m^2 for L = 10 m, B = 1 m, T = 0.625 m; the value quoted in the module doc is the quadrature result actually returned.
entries.acceptance: live composite Gauss-Legendre value equals the documented 14.879063105 m^2 to 1e-9 relative (the doc quotes 10 significant figures)

entries.title: Mesh-integrated Wigley volume on the default 41 x 13 grid (documented measurement)
entries.claim: The default grid integrates V = 2.7712221 m^3, i.e. -0.236 % against the closed form 25/9 -- the discretisation error that the convergence table reports.
entries.acceptance: docs/wigley.md convergence table still reports the default-grid volume 2.7712221 m^3 (doc drift detector; the value is a mesh measurement, so it is pinned in prose, not recomputed by the guard)

entries.title: Analytic displacement of the default parametric hull (L/B/T = 10/2.0/0.8)
entries.claim: V = B L T I 2/3 = 7.512698 m^3 with taper integral I = 0.7043154582422714, matching the mesh route (7.446554 m^3, -0.88 %) recorded in the m241 audit.
entries.acceptance: live taper integral equals 0.7043154582422714 to 1e-15 relative; the audit artifact still records analytic 7.512698 and mesh 7.446554; README still quotes both

artifacts.note: audit artifact rounded to 6 decimal places

entries.title: Order-4 curved elements integrate the sphere volume to 2.06e-7 relative
entries.claim: On 24 order-4 elements (2x2 subdivisions per knot span) the volume is 4.1887910675460525 m^3 against 4/3 pi = 4.1887902047863905 m^3, a relative error of 2.06e-7, i.e. the benchmark gate J3 criterion (<= 1e-6) holds with 5x margin.
entries.acceptance: pinned artifact values reproduced exactly at their JSON pointers and gate J3 recorded as passed

entries.title: Order-6 elements cut the sphere volume error to 8.24e-11 (order-4 value preserved as the reference)
entries.claim: Volume 4.188790205131541 m^3, relative error 8.24e-11 -- three more digits than the order-4 row, which is the p-refinement evidence the gate J6 fitted order is built on.
entries.acceptance: pinned artifact values reproduced exactly at their JSON pointers

entries.title: Exact barge GZ peaks at 0.175598 m at 45 deg and is still 0.091252 m at 80 deg
entries.claim: For the example barge B = 2.0 m, T = 0.8 m, D = 1.2 m, KG = 0.55 m the clipped-section solver returns GZ(45 deg) = 0.1755981839946591 m in the bilge-and-deck regime and GZ(80 deg) = 0.09125182565735745 m -- the range of stability the one-line wall-sided formula cannot describe.
entries.acceptance: live exact section values equal the two documented arms to 1e-12 relative; the quoted doc sentences survive

entries.title: Inside its window the wall-sided closed form agrees with the exact section to 2e-16
entries.claim: At 10 deg the one-line wall-sided formula gives 0.04743095798991253 m and the clipped-section solver 0.04743095798991254 m: the closed form is exact there, which is why it may be used for the 1-15 deg band.
entries.acceptance: both routes equal their recorded arms to 1e-12 relative and agree with each other to 1e-12 relative

entries.title: Wall-sided validity limit of the example barge is atan(T/(B/2)) = 38.6598 deg
entries.claim: box_wall_sided_limit_deg(2.0, 0.8) = 38.659808254090095 deg = atan(0.8): past it the deck edge or bilge enters and the one-line formula stops being the answer.
entries.acceptance: live limit angle equals atan(0.8) to 1e-12 relative

entries.title: SUBOFF bare-hull voxel volume against the published displacement
entries.claim: Voxel integration of the SUBOFF bare hull gives 0.698982 m^3 against the published 0.699211 m^3 (-0.033 %), while hard cell counting is +1.18 % -- the partial-fill estimator is what makes the voxel route usable as a geometry source.
entries.acceptance: docs/voxel_export.md still quotes both the measured 0.698982 m^3 and the published 0.699211 m^3 (doc drift detector; the grid is a 218x26x26 measurement, not recomputed by the guard)
